title: Ellington's drummers after Sonny Greer and Louie Bellson
summary: They list the drummers after Sonny, from Bellson to Sam Woodyard; Bigard says most could not cut the mustard and Bellson was good but his marriage to Pearl Bailey ended it.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah, because he couldn't do his job. But the guy that he got was just as bad as Sonny. What's that? -- Woodward, Woodyard?
